search.randomness: none -- search path is deterministic for a given input and stop rule

stopping.note: Work-based stop: results identical on any machine. The time cap only prevents a hang; a run that reaches it is flagged stop_reason=time_cap and is not a frozen result.

distance_convention.note: TSPLIB/CVRPLIB nint rounding. Python round() is NOT used (banker's rounding differs on .5 cases).

fleet_rule: max_vehicles is supplied by the caller per run (see reference_bks.json); never inferred by the solver from the file name
hardware_note: Recorded per run in results CSV; not needed to reproduce results because stopping is work-based
